skills.name: architect
skills.description: Think through what you are about to build like a senior engineer before writing any code. Use before writing code, when planning a feature, or when the user runs /architect.

skills.name: remember
skills.description: Save what matters at the end of a session, or restore context at the start of a new one. Use when the user runs /remember, /remember save, or /remember restore.

skills.name: review
skills.description: After building a feature, verify it matches the plan, respects the architecture, and is production-ready. Use after implementing a feature, before shipping, or when the user runs /review.

skills.name: recover
skills.description: Diagnose whether a failure needs a targeted fix, a hard reset, or a full rethink. Use when a build is broken, a session is going in circles, or the user runs /recover.

skills.name: imprint
skills.description: Extract visual patterns from a UI component into ui-registry.md so later components match. Use after building UI or when the user runs /imprint or /imprint audit.
